content: Karasaras en Ikel oh Tuhkehn Wain
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, ndaiong mehn Israel kan karasaras ehu

pwe re en ese dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanihong irail: Mie lapalahn ikel men me wune lingan oh eh pehnpihr kan inenen lapala. E ahpw pihrlahng pohn nahna kan en Lepanon oh katipwasang kadoken tuhke sidar pwoat,
ih eri pihrkilahng rahntuhkeo ni sahpw en netinet ehu oh kihdiong nan kahnimw ehu en sounnetinet kan.
E ahpw pil ale kisin tuhke pwulopwul kis sang nan wehin Israel oh padokedi nan sahpw pwelmwahu ehu, wasa me pihl kin mie ahnsou koaros pwehn kakairada.
Kisin tuhkeo eri keirda oh wiahla tuhke wain losolos ehu. Rah ko uhdalahng rehn ikelo, oh kalowe kan kohdiong pahn pwehl. Tuhkehn waino inenen rarahn oh tehn.

“Pil mie emen lapalahn ikel me eh pehnpihr kan pil lapala oh wune kan mosul mehlel. Eri, kalowen tuhkehn waino ahpw wosalahng reh oh pil rah kan penglahng wasa me ikelo mihmi ie, e koapworopowrki me e pahn kak ale pihl sang rehn ikelo me laudsang pihl me mi nan mwaht me e kekeirda ieo.
Ahpw tuhkehn waino poadidier nan mwaht pwelmwahu, oh diren pihl pwe en kak losolos oh wahn oh wiahla tuhke kaselel pwoat.

“Eri ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ahpw keinemwe: Ia duwe, tuhke pwoatet kak mour oh keirda? Keieun ikelo soh pahn usada kalowe kan oh kihsang wah kan, oh katipwasang rah kan oh mweidohng en mengila? E sohte anahne ehu wehi kehlail oh manaman en usadahsang.
Ei, e poadidier, ahpw e pahn keirda oh mour? E soh pahn mengila ni ahnsou me kisinieng en palimese pahn lel? E soh pahn mengila wasa me e kekeirda ieo?”
Karasarso kawehwehda
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong ie,

“Idek rehn aramas kahngohdi pwukat ma re ese wehwehn karasaraso. Ndaiong irail me nanmwarkien Papilonia ketidohr Serusalem oh ketikihsang nanmwarkio oh sapwellime lapalap akan oh ketikilahng Papilonia.
E ahpw ketikihla emen peneinei en nanmwarkio, oh wiahiong ih inou lap ehu, oh mahsanihong en kahukihla me e pahn loalopwoat. E ahpw salihedi ekei ohl kesempwal ko
oh ketikihsang pwehn kak kerempwahla wehio en dehr uhwong oh re en dadaurete inou lapo.

Ahpw nanmwarkien Suda pelianda oh kadarala meninkeder kei Isip pwe re en ale oahs oh karis en sounpei kalaimwun ehu. Ia duwe, e pahn kak pweida? E pahn kak pitsang ire wet? E sohte kak kauwehla inou lapo ahpw sohte ale kalokepe!”

KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ahpw mahsanih, “Nin duwen ngehi, Koht ieias, nanmwarki menet pahn sipalla nan Papilonia, pwehki eh kauwehla sapwellime kahula oh inou lapo me e wiahiong nanmwarkien Papilonia, me kasapwiladahng ih nan mwoale.
Pil sapwellimen nanmwarkien Isip karis kehlailo sohte kak sewese mahwen ni ahnsou me mehn Papilonia kan pahn wiahda warawar oh mehn poadoandoar kei pwe re en kak kemehla aramas tohto.
E kauwehla sapwellime kahula oh inou lapo me e wiadahr. E wiadahr soahng pwukat koaros, oh e sohte pahn pitsang.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, eri mahsanih, “Nin duwen ngehi, Koht ieias, I pahn kalokehki eh kauwehla inou lapo me e kahukihla ni mwarei me e pahn dadaurete.
I pahn pahkpeseng ei uhk oh kalowehdi loale. I pahn ketikilahng Papilonia oh kaloke wasao, pwehki e soaloalopwoatohng ie.
Sapwellime sounpei keieu kehlail kan pahn mehla nan mahwen, oh me mourla kan pahn mwarahkpeseng wasa koaros. Eri, kumwail ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
Sapwellimen Koht Inoun Koapworopwor
Iet me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, mahsanih:

content.text: “I pahn ale ehu kadoken tuhke sidar
oh katipwasang apwoat kisin rah pwulopwul;
I ahpw pahn padokedi pohn nahna ileile ehu,
pohn nahna keieu ileile en Israel.
E ahpw pahn kadarala rah kan oh wa
oh wiahla tuhke sidar kaselel pwoat.
Soangen menpihr koaros pahn kousoan wasao
Tuhke koaros nan wehio pahn ese
Ngehi me lupukedi tuhke reirei kan
oh mweidohng tuhke mwotomwot kan en reireila.
Ngehi me kamangedi tuhke losolos kan
oh mweidohng tuhke meng kan en losolosala.

content: Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen. I pahn kapwaiada dahme I mahsaniher me I pahn wia.”
